[orthogonality of images and kernels]

Source: petersen:page-0373 ↗ def:pet-ch9-codifferential 1. ch9:9.6.3In $\Omega ^k(M)$ for an oriented Riemannian manifold, establish \[ (\operatorname {im}d^{k-1})^\perp =\ker \delta ^{k-1}, \qquad \operatorname {im}d^{k-1}\subset (\ker \delta ^{k-1})^\perp . \]
